tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记数据库迁移
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and user association in the backend framework.
T1.notes: Ensure proper validation for required fields and relationships.

T2.implementation_approach: Generate a database migration script to create a notes table with appropriate columns and constraints.
T2.notes: Run the migration to apply changes to the database.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes, including authentication and authorization checks.
T3.notes: Use pagination for listing notes and handle errors gracefully.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page with a form for creating/editing notes and a list view for displaying existing notes.
T4.notes: Use a modern frontend framework and integrate it with the API.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature in the API using query parameters and integrate it with the frontend to filter notes dynamically.
T5.notes: Consider using full-text search or indexing for better performance.
